App.name: Mango Works
App.description: Rental management for vehicle rental shops

Login.title: Sign in
Login.intro: Sign in to your shop's workspace.
Login.wrongPassword: That email and password don't match.
Login.useLink: Email me a sign-in link instead
Login.usePassword: Sign in with a password instead
Login.sent: Check your email for a sign-in link. It works for one hour.
Login.sendFailed: We couldn't send the link. Try again in a minute.
Login.errorSignin: Sign-in didn't finish. Please try again.
Login.errorLink: That link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.

Picker.title: Choose a shop
Picker.intro: You work in more than one shop. Which one now?
Picker.noShopTitle: You're not in a shop yet
Picker.noShopBody: You're signed in as {email}, but no shop has added you to its team. Ask the shop owner to add you, then sign in again.

Dashboard.title: What's coming up
Dashboard.lateIntro: Overdue or failed: needs action now.

Orders.title: Orders
Orders.searchPlaceholder: Order number, name, phone, passport or plate
Orders.noResults: Orders arrive in Phase 3. Your search and filter are kept in the address, so you can bookmark them.

NewOrder.title: New order
NewOrder.intro: Book a bike and take payment. These steps fill in as the phases land.

Maintenance.title: Maintenance
Maintenance.due: Due and overdue across the fleet
Maintenance.searchHelp: Type a plate or frame number, or scan a bike's QR sticker with your phone camera.
Maintenance.dueLater: Service and renewal alerts arrive in Phase 1b.

Team.title: Team
Team.intro: Everyone who works in {shop}, and what they can do.
Team.name: Name
Team.inviteLater: Inviting new people arrives in Phase 11. Until then, ask Mango Works to add them.
Team.errorLastOwner: A shop needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
Team.errorGeneric: That didn't work. Please try again.

Settings.title: Shop settings
Settings.intro: Every price, report and reminder uses these. Nothing assumes a country.
Settings.name: Shop name
Settings.localeHelp: A language tag such as en-GB, th-TH or ja-JP.
Settings.readOnly: Only owners and managers can change these.

errors.invalidCountry: Choose a country from the list.
errors.invalidCurrency: Choose a currency from the list.
errors.invalidLocale: Use a language tag such as en-GB.
errors.currencyLocked: The currency can't change once prices have been saved in it.

Settings.distanceUnitHelp: Odometer readings are always stored in km and shown in this unit.
Settings.currencyLockedHelp: Locked: prices have been saved in this currency.
Settings.timezoneMoved: Time zone, address, opening hours and closures are set per location. <link>Open locations</link>

Me.title: You and this device
Me.deviceIntro: These choices are saved on this device only.
Me.tabBarHelp: Where the four tabs sit on a phone or tablet. On a wide screen they're in the sidebar.
Me.installHelp: On a phone, open the browser menu and choose “Add to Home screen”. On a computer, use the install icon in the address bar. It's optional: everything also works in the browser.

Offline.title: You're offline
Offline.body: Check your connection and try again.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: It may have moved, or you don't have access to it.

FormErrors.invalidNumber: Enter a whole number in range.
FormErrors.invalidMoney: Enter an amount, such as 45000 or 45000.50.
FormErrors.invalidPhone: Use the international format, such as +66850550247.
FormErrors.invalidUrl: Enter a link that starts with https://
FormErrors.invalidTimezone: Choose a time zone from the list.
FormErrors.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
FormErrors.plateOrPending: Enter the plate, or tick “Plate pending”.
FormErrors.plateExists: Another bike in this shop already has that plate.
FormErrors.nameExists: That name is already used in this shop.
FormErrors.inUse: It is still in use, so it can't be deleted.
FormErrors.blockOverlap: This bike is already blocked for part of that time. Pick other times, or end the other block first.
FormErrors.unit_has_future_blocks: This bike still has a block that ends in the future. End or remove it first.
FormErrors.unit_not_in_fleet: This bike has been sold or retired, so it can't be blocked.
FormErrors.more_units_than_active: Instant plus Request units, and Ready now, can't be more than the model's active bikes.
FormErrors.catalog_entry_not_usable: Choose a catalog entry from the list.
FormErrors.odometer_lower_needs_manager: That reading is lower than the last one. Ask a manager to correct it.
FormErrors.only_owner_or_manager: Only an owner or manager can change that.
FormErrors.currency_locked: The currency can't change once prices have been saved in it.
FormErrors.timezoneOwnerOnly: Only an owner can change a location's time zone.
FormErrors.keepDefaultLocation: A shop keeps its main location.

Fleet.title: Fleet
Fleet.intro: {units, plural, =0 {No bikes yet} one {# bike} other {# bikes}} in {models, plural, one {# model} other {# models}}.
Fleet.empty: No bikes yet. Add a model, then its bikes, or import them all from a CSV file.

import.title: Import bikes from CSV
import.intro: One row per bike. The whole file is checked first: if any row has a problem, nothing is saved.
import.columnsHelp: Only “model” is required. A new model also needs “catalog” (the entry's code from the list below). Leave “plate” blank for a bike without one yet. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; odometer is in {unit}; purchase price is in {currency}.
import.done: Imported {units, plural, one {# bike} other {# bikes}} and {models, plural, =0 {no new models} one {# new model} other {# new models}}.
import.problems: {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}} found. Nothing was imported.

errors.tooLarge: That file is too big (limit 1 MB).
errors.noFile: Choose a file or paste the rows.
errors.unclosedQuote: A quote opened on this line is never closed.
errors.unknownColumn: This column isn't one of the import columns.
errors.noRows: The file has a header but no bikes.
errors.tooManyRows: A file can hold at most 1,000 bikes.
errors.catalogNeeded: This is a new model, so it needs a catalog code.
errors.catalogUnknown: No catalog entry has this code.
errors.catalogMismatch: This model has a different catalog code on an earlier line.
errors.plateDuplicateInFile: This plate appears on an earlier line.
errors.plateExists: A bike in your fleet already has this plate.
errors.invalidDate: Not a date in YYYY-MM-DD form.
errors.invalidMoney: Not an amount in your currency.
errors.saveFailed: The file passed the checks but couldn't be saved. Nothing was imported.

import.showCodes: Show {count, plural, one {# code} other {# codes}}

Fleet.noUnits: No bikes of this model yet.

model.name: Name
model.nameHelp: Your own name for it. Several models can share one catalog entry.
model.catalogHelp: Sets the engine size and transmission renters search by.
model.catalogMissing: Not in the list? Request a new entry
model.bufferHelp: Blank uses the shop default (set in Phase 2).
model.depositHelp: Blank uses the shop default (set in Phase 2).
model.modesHelp: How many of the active bikes confirm instantly and how many need your OK. The rest are for walk-ins only.
model.deleteConfirm: Delete this model? This can't be undone.
model.photosLater: Photos are added with the online booking page.

unit.platePendingWarning: This bike has no plate yet. Staff are warned before check-out.
unit.workHelp: A reading lower than the last one needs a manager.
unit.deleteConfirm: Delete this bike? This can't be undone.
unit.readOnly: You can view this bike but not change it.

downtime.title: Downtime
downtime.intro: Blocks this bike from bookings. Times are {zone} time.
downtime.untilHelp: Leave blank to block it until someone ends it.

money.title: Purchase and sale
money.intro: Only owners and managers see this.
money.sellHelp: Removes the bike from availability. Its future blocks must be moved or ended first.

sticker.title: QR sticker
sticker.help: Scan it with a phone camera to open this bike. It only works for people signed in to your shop.
sticker.sheetIntro: {count, plural, one {# sticker} other {# stickers}}. Print on label paper or plain paper and cut.

catalogRequest.title: Request a catalog entry
catalogRequest.intro: Mango Works checks each new entry. You can use it for your own models straight away.

Locations.title: Locations
Locations.intro: Each location has its own time zone, address, opening hours and closures.
Locations.name: Name
Locations.timezoneHelp: Opening hours, due dates and “today” at this location use it.
Locations.timezoneOwner: Only an owner can change the time zone.
Locations.timezoneWarning: Changing the time zone moves every opening hour and due date of this location. Save anyway?
Locations.hoursHelp: Leave both times blank on a day the location is closed.
Locations.deleteConfirm: Delete this location? This can't be undone.
Locations.unitCount: {count, plural, =0 {No bikes} one {# bike} other {# bikes}}

Admin.title: Catalog requests
Admin.intro: Entries shops have asked for. Approving one opens it to every shop.
Admin.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
